QuestInfo.name: Tower of the Future
QuestInfo.0: The duo decided they would try to to stop time in #m327000000#... but how? They hoped that #b#p2470000##k would know how.
QuestInfo.1: #p2470001# directed them to the Westernmost tower in #m327000000#, and gave them a strange task to perform. They would need to shake the #b#p2470039##k until a #r#o9300796##k came out!
QuestInfo.2: The duo managed to stop time in the future Ludibrium.

0.0: The future must be stopped as well. Go to the #btower in the west#k of Ludibrium.
0.1: That tower will take you to the #btown of the future#k. If you can stop time there, it will stop time for good.

yes.0: You should see the #b#p2470039##k at the center of town when you arrive... It is a magical relic that only those of us with time powers can see.
yes.1: You will need to shake the #r#o9300796##k creatures loose from inside. Eliminate them, and the flow of time will stop.

1.0: I feel the future standing still.

yes.0: Ludibrium will take some time to stop completely. We will need to watch, and wait.
